column7: Every access-request transition (project request/approve/2-of-N partial approve/reject, secret request/approve/reject, and bulk approve/reject through them) notifies AFTER its own state change commits. A CreateNotification panic escaped that step, so the committed approval (role grant, approval row, request state, audit) was answered with HTTP 500 (FuzzStorageFaultOperations oracle (a), PUT /projects/{id}/access-requests/{requestId}, CreateNotification#1/panic); a CreateNotification error was swallowed with no trace. Fixed by core.runPostCommitNotification: panic or error is recovered, logged at SECURITY: WARN with step/request/project/actor, and audited as notification.failed, and the success response stands. Fuzz-level pin: server/faultops TestAccessRequestNotificationFailure_IsNotReportedAsFailure. Red before the fix: 14/14 core rows and 8/8 fuzz rows.
